newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIAN CABINET TO DISCUSS AGRICULTURAL BANK PRICE.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIAN CABINET TO DISCUSS AGRICULTURAL BANK PRICE.

text.p: The government will discuss the new share issue price of state-run Agricultural Bank at a cabinet meeting on Wednesday, the government press office said on Monday.
"It has been suggested that a share issue price of 175 litas be set," the office said in a statement.
The face-value of the bank's also stands at 175 litas.
The bank decided last month to boost its share capital by 42.875 million litas to meet the capital adequacy ratio requirements established by the country's central bank.
The current share capital of the bank stands at 128 million litas.
The second biggest bank in terms of assets is 86 percent state run and is one of the two banks slated for privatisation by Lithuanian government.
